an6.118:1.1: 119 cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ajjhattaṃ kāye kāyānupassī viharituṃ …pe…
an6.118:1.3: ajjhattabahiddhā kāye 120 cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharitaṃ …pe…
an6.118:1.6: ajjhattabahiddhā vedanāsu 121 cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo citte cittānupassī viharituṃ …pe…
an6.118:1.9: ajjhattabahiddhā citte 122 cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo dhammesu dhammānupassī viharituṃ …pe…
an6.118:1.14: kammārāmataṃ bhassārāmataṃ niddārāmataṃ saṃgaṇikārāmataṃ indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ bhojane amattaññutaṃ ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharituṃ. 123 cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharituṃ katame cha kammārāmataṃ …pe… bhojane amattaññutaṃ
an6.118:1.15: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharitunti.
